vintage: ODRÉ national energy registry; RTE network statistics, 2025

lenses.name: Solar capacity
lenses.description: Installed solar-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex; small installations are represented through ODRÉ commune aggregates.

lenses.name: Wind capacity
lenses.description: Installed wind-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: Hydro capacity
lenses.description: Installed hydroelectric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry, including conventional, run-of-river, pumped-storage and tidal installations where present. Commune capacities are aggregated by map hex.

lenses.name: Nuclear capacity
lenses.description: Installed nuclear-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Per-capita normalization is only a spatial intensity measure: electricity is transmitted nationally rather than consumed solely by nearby residents.

lenses.name: Renewable capacity
lenses.description: Installed renewable-electric capacity per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Hydro includes pumped-storage and tidal installations where present, so the total is generation-capacity infrastructure rather than a strict annual renewable-generation measure.

lenses.name: Non-hydro storage
lenses.description: Installed non-hydraulic electricity-storage power per resident from the ODRÉ national registry. Values use the registry's maximum installed power field; energy duration in MWh is not available in this national extract.

lenses.name: Low-carbon capacity share
lenses.description: Nuclear plus renewable installed capacity as a share of non-storage generation capacity. This is nameplate capacity, not generated electricity or emissions; hydro includes pumped-storage infrastructure.

lenses.name: Transmission network density
lenses.description: Total RTE transmission-circuit length per 100 km² by department in 2025. Circuits count each electrical circuit, so a double-circuit line contributes twice; values are departmental infrastructure density, not exact line locations.

lenses.name: High-voltage network density
lenses.description: RTE transmission-circuit length at 225 kV, 400 kV and direct current per 100 km² by department in 2025. This highlights the backbone transmission network rather than lower-voltage regional transmission.

lenses.name: Non-overhead transmission share
lenses.description: Underground or submarine RTE transmission-circuit kilometres as a share of all circuit kilometres by department in 2025. Most of the transmission network remains overhead.

lenses.name: Transmission circuit stacking
lenses.description: Overhead RTE circuit kilometres divided by pylon-route kilometres by department in 2025. Values above one indicate multiple electrical circuits sharing the same pylons or corridor. Departmental ratios below one are treated as missing because independently allocated circuit and pylon-route lengths can be internally inconsistent near department boundaries.

lenses.name: Transformation-site density
lenses.description: Operating RTE electricity-transformation sites per 1,000 km² by department. The public registry lists most sites by department without exact coordinates; connection points are excluded. Registry rows whose department field is blank are omitted rather than guessed.

lenses.name: High-voltage transformation sites
lenses.description: Operating RTE electricity-transformation sites at 225 kV, 400 kV or direct current per 1,000 km² by department. The public registry lists most sites by department without exact coordinates. Registry rows whose department field is blank are omitted rather than guessed.

lenses.name: Grid connection points
lenses.description: Operating RTE points de piquage—customer or network connection points—per 1,000 km² by department. Exact locations are not published in the current security-aware open-data extract, and registry rows whose department field is blank are omitted rather than guessed.
